adjudication.rationale: In `addGuests.handler.ts`, the initial `prisma.booking.findFirst` includes `user: { include: { destinationCalendar: true, credentials: true } }`, which loads the booking organizer’s credential records into memory. The handler never reads `booking.user.credentials`; instead it later calls `getUsersCredentials(ctx.user)` for the acting user. This is an unnecessary access to sensitive data (and extra query payload), but it doesn’t appear to cause incorrect behavior or leak it to the client in this diff.
